questions.stem: Which of the following objects is likely to weigh more than 1 kilogram?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'A bag of rice' because it is a heavy object that is likely to weigh more than 1 kilogram. A pencil and a matchbox are light objects, and a feather is extremely light.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct way to compare the weight of two objects?
choices: By feeling them with your hands
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'By using a pan-balance' because it is the most accurate and scientific way to compare the weight of two objects. Looking at size, feeling with hands, or guessing can be misleading.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an object that weighs about 1 kilogram?
questions.solution: A salt packet is an example of an object that weighs about 1 kilogram because it is a common household item with a weight close to that measure. A feather is extremely light, a pencil is much lighter than 1 kilogram, and a matchbox also weighs significantly less than 1 kilogram.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 1 किलोग्राम के लगभग भार वाले वस्तु का उदाहरण है?

questions.stem: If a jug holds exactly 1 litre of water, which of the following is most likely to hold less than 1 litre?
questions.solution: A glass is most likely to hold less than 1 litre. A bottle and a bucket are usually larger than a glass, and a measuring cup is designed to hold exactly 1 litre. Therefore, the glass is the best choice.

hi.stem: यदि एक बर्तन में ठीक 1 लीटर पानी आता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा लगभग 1 लीटर से कम आता है?
hi.solution: एक गिलास लगभग 1 लीटर से कम आता है। एक बोतल और एक बाल्टी आमतौर पर एक गिलास से बड़ी होती हैं, और एक मापन कप को ठीक 1 लीटर आवंटित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इसलिए, गिलास सबसे अच्छा विकल्प है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and maintains the correct answer and distractors.

questions.critique: The solution is sound and aligns with the correct answer. A glass is typically smaller than a jug, while a bottle and bucket are usually larger, and a measuring cup is designed to hold exactly 1 litre.

questions.stem: Using a pan-balance, how many times do you need to weigh to find the heaviest ball among three balls of different weights?
questions.solution: Once is correct because you can place two balls on the pan-balance. If one side is heavier, that ball is the heaviest. If they balance, the third ball not weighed is the heaviest. Weighing twice, three times, or four times is unnecessary since the heaviest can be determined in a single comparison.

hi.stem: तीन अलग-अलग भार वाले गेंदों में से सबसे भारी गेंद को खोजने के लिए पैन-बैलेंस का उपयोग करके कितनी बार भार डालने की आवश्यकता होती है?
hi.solution: एक बार सही है क्योंकि आप दो गेंदों को पैन-बैलेंस पर रख सकते हैं। यदि एक तरफ भारी होती है, तो वह गेंद सबसे भारी होती है। यदि वे संतुलित हो जाते हैं, तो भार नहीं डाली गई तीसरी गेंद सबसे भारी होती है। दो, तीन या चार बार भार डालना आवश्यक नहीं है क्योंकि सबसे भारी एक ही तुलना में निर्धारित किया जा सकता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate terminology. The correct answer (1) is in the same position as in the English version. All distractors remain incorrect.

questions.stem: If a bottle holds 1 litre and a glass holds a quarter litre, how many glasses are needed to fill the bottle?
questions.solution: If a bottle holds 1 litre and a glass holds a quarter litre, 4 glasses are needed to fill the bottle. This is because 1 litre divided by a quarter litre equals 4. The other options do not match this calculation.
